scripts.test:sandbox: bash scripts/build-sputnik.sh && pnpm build:contracts && pnpm build:callback-fixture && cargo test -p captab-company --test sandbox
scripts.build:contract: cargo clean --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo build -p captab-company --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.build:contracts: cargo clean --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo build -p captab-company -p captab-test-token --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.build:callback-fixture: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/callback-failure cargo clean --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/callback-failure cargo build -p captab-company --features sandbox-failed-callback --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
